selection_policy: Latest user instruction: only useful workflows and UX; vendors are examples, not mandatory connectors. All prior goal scope remains.
corrections: ASC and selected build/localized keyword/release-note reads already exist.
Apple attribution, Apple Ads reports, local follow-up and verified webhook intake already exist.
Unverified revenue-share percentages and blanket product suitability verdicts are not adopted.
shared_requirements: Human and agent parity through existing UI/CLI/MCP contracts.
Plain-language purpose, inputs, delivered result and next action with progressive disclosure.
Observed versus unavailable metrics, active progress, actionable recovery and source-linked history.
Analytics and PDF/data export for each implemented workflow using existing privacy boundaries.
Exact human or already-authorized standing scope for effects; imports never grant credentials or authority.
Reuse domain stores and bounded adapters; measure before claiming speed or savings.
deferred: Blanket integration of every named MMP, CRM, ad network or intelligence vendor.
Duplicate Apple connectors, schedulers, attribution stores or creative libraries.
Unlicensed scraping, inferred ad performance, automatic spend and unapproved external delivery.

requirements.title: Unified iOS release and listing readiness
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: ASC selected version/build, localized keywords/release notes, subscriptions and reviews exist.
requirements.required_workflow: Join existing iOS facts to pipeline blockers with source time, missing access and a concrete repair. Add TestFlight/crash reads where they support a release decision.
acceptance: No duplicate Apple connector; selected app/build/locale and partial pagination remain explicit.
Stale, foreign-app and permission failures reject; unavailable TestFlight/crash data stays unknown.

requirements.title: Attribution to campaign CPA and mature ROAS
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: Apple native attribution and ad reports exist; MMP cohort/cost joins are missing.
requirements.required_workflow: Import permitted MMP and cost exports; map exact app/campaign/creative cohorts to costs and revenue for spend-review decisions. Add native connections when recurring use justifies them.
acceptance: D7/D30 include cohort dates, maturity, currency, timezone, attribution model/window, revenue basis and refunds.
Missing cost/revenue or zero denominators yield unavailable metrics; incompatible sources and overlapping revenue cannot be summed.
Deduplication, unmatched coverage, foreign apps, bad units and saved provenance are tested.

requirements.title: Campaign brief to validated upload bundle
requirements.current_coverage: MISSING broader network export; Apple Ads observations and bounded provider actions exist.
requirements.required_workflow: Build campaign/ad-group-or-ad-set/ad drafts from objective, audience, budget, bid and rights-cleared creative; review diff and export platform-specific CSV/JSON. Start with Apple Ads and the user-selected network.
acceptance: Validate hierarchy, required fields, budget/currency units, destinations, assets, locale and keyword match types.
Preview exact outbound fields, schema version and errors; prove round-trip against a provider-format fixture.
DRAFT_EXPORTED is separate from provider accepted/active; no export activates spending.

requirements.title: Review inbox to approved response draft
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: ASC review reads exist; unified Apple/Play triage and response drafts are missing.
requirements.required_workflow: Filter reviews by issue, rating, recency and response status; link product evidence and draft an editable reply. Preserve original text and separate sentiment inference from confirmed incidents.
acceptance: Show coverage, deduplication, translation/source distinction and draft history.
Draft, approved and published remain distinct; posting needs exact approval and readback.
Human and agent can inspect/edit; private identifiers stay out of model context and exports.

requirements.title: Retention problem to consented lifecycle experiment
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: local follow-up policy, eligibility and handoff exist; CRM lifecycle tracking is missing.
requirements.required_workflow: Draft push/in-app/email variants; select consented segment, quiet hours, cap, schedule and holdout; approve export/handoff and import delivery/conversion/unsubscribe outcomes. Add the connected CRM adapter required by this workflow.
acceptance: Extend existing follow-up instead of a second scheduler; suppression and withdrawn consent prevent dispatch.
Scheduled, handed off, delivered and converted remain distinct; missing delivery is unknown.
Replay, timezone, cancellation, revocation and stale-segment approvals are tested.

requirements.title: Competitor evidence to a testable hypothesis
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: benchmarks and creative library exist; competitor export/feed ingestion is missing.
requirements.required_workflow: Attach permitted listing, keyword and ad-library evidence to existing libraries; compare exact date/locale/category and create an experiment hypothesis. Prefer user-owned exports before paid feeds.
acceptance: Show provider, date, licensed scope, estimated versus observed data and missing coverage.
Library presence does not prove ad performance or authorize reuse; existing rights and viral thresholds remain.
Stale/incomparable observations cannot become winning claims; preserve links into the hypothesis.

requirements.title: Previewed reusable CSV/JSON evidence intake
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: typed imports and snapshots exist; provider-export mapping preview is missing.
requirements.required_workflow: Share bounded mapping preview, row validation, duplicate review and atomic import across attribution, costs, lifecycle and competitor evidence; save noncredential mapping templates.
acceptance: Reject bad schemas, duplicate columns/keys, oversized files/rows/depth and formula injection on spreadsheet export.
Failed import preserves prior data; credentials and reusable authority cannot be imported.
Retain app scope, source hash, mapping version, units and coverage; replay is idempotent.

requirements.title: Verified event to prioritized review task
requirements.current_coverage: PARTIAL: signed payment/StoreKit/attribution intake exists; marketing review rules are missing.
requirements.required_workflow: Turn verified imported/provider events or mature metric thresholds into deduplicated tasks with evidence, reason and next action. Support dry-run, pause, threshold edits and links to telemetry/history.
acceptance: Test authentication/signature failure, stale/duplicate/late delivery, cooldown and recovery.
Decline rules require baseline, window, maturity and sample; missing data cannot manufacture a decline.
Events prepare tasks only; no implicit publication, spend, external message or public server exposure.
